description: MT940 end-of-month statement with field 25P (Account with BIC), field 64 (Closing Available Balance), and multiple field 65 (Forward Available Balance) entries showing projected future balances.
test_coverage: Field 25P instead of field 25 (Account Identification with BIC)
Multiple transactions demonstrating common month-end activities (revenue, payroll, rent)
Field 64 (Closing Available Balance) matching closing balance
Multiple field 65 (Forward Available Balance) entries for different future dates
business_rules_expected_to_pass: Balance consistency: opening 250000 + credits (50000) - debits (45000+12000) = closing 243000
Available balance equals closing balance (no holds)
notes: This statement demonstrates a typical month-end scenario with revenue collection and monthly expense payments (payroll and rent). Field 25P is used instead of field 25, which includes the account servicing institution BIC (CHASUS33) along with the account number. Field 64 shows the available balance equals the closing balance (no funds on hold). Field 65 appears twice to show forward available balances: one for the next business day (December 1) maintaining the same balance, and another for mid-month (December 15) showing an expected increase to USD 265,000 due to anticipated incoming payments. This is useful for cash flow forecasting and treasury management.
